title: Handmade Hero Day 001 - Setting Up the Windows Build
summary: Day 1 of Casey Muratori's Handmade Hero, a live-coded game built from scratch in C on Windows. It reviews C on Windows, sets up a minimal build system and WinMain entry point, and shows a first MessageBox.
why: HN recommends the series as a thorough look at low-level game programming by someone with deep knowledge, offered free.

categories.name: C, C++, Rust, Go & systems languages

quote.text: the amount of knowledge and experience on-show was incredible
